claims.assertion: Athena says temporal travelers encounter multiple possible futures, not one fixed destination, and estimate a likely outcome by comparing variants.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: She compares 3D reality to sequential rooms and 5D to interconnected floors; higher-density complexity makes those minds hard for 3D people to understand.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena describes timelines and densities as perception ranges, not separate worlds; each present reflects many variants, while timeline remains a useful limited label.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Her account explicitly treats timelines as imprecise human terminology.
